title: Great way to see city highlights

We had a small group which was great! Thank you

title: Fernando was an...
text: Fernando was an energetic, fun, and very knowledgeable tour guide. We had a lot of fun and would definitely tell anyone we know traveling to Seville to go on this bike tour.
author: Jodi_R

title: Great Bike Tour
text: Pablo was a great tour guide! He was full of information about so many parts of Seville. He really made us understand the roots of this city   I loved this tour.
author: Matt_D

title: Seville on a bike
text: See the beautiful sights of the city, comfortably on a bike! A fun, enthusiastic guide.

title: Fun and Informative  tour with a different twist
text: Emilio was a great guide -- amusing and informative (and irreverent, in a good way).   Learning the untold history and seeing back streets as well as the most famous locations.  Doing the tour on our first day in Seville has helped us navigate things better the rest of our time here. We would recommend this tour.
author: Kris_N
